comment: Advisory performance budget (design §19.2 item 1, docs/performance.md): ci/bench-report.py warns when a result exceeds one and never fails the job. Recalibrated on 2026-10-13 from the first three CI runs (six jobs; GitHub ubuntu-24.04, 4 CPUs, loop filesystems), which drew two CPU types, AMD EPYC 7763 and Intel Xeon 6973P-C, with fsync-bound results up to about 1.7 times apart: each limit is about 1.5 times the slowest of the six. Workloads are budgeted in absolute time: the plain-directory baselines varied threefold between runners, so ratios against them are reported but not budgeted. The double record was removed afterwards (design §19.2 item 4): the two runs since made one record per boundary, and the mvdir budgets come from those four jobs.
